subject: MAP & Ops Passport — milestone commitments and CS handoff
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sam Park <sam.park@novusware.com>, Priya Desai <priya.desai@novusware.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: MAP & Ops Passport — milestone commitments and CS handoff

Hi Sam / Priya,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. Per our call I put together the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan ("Ops Passport") and an initial milestone commitment list so we can align on responsibilities and target dates. Attachment: NovusWare_MAP_v1.xlsx (worksheet: Milestones + Owners).

High-level proposed milestones (please confirm or suggest changes):
- M1: API keys & test dataset available (NovusWare) — Target: 2026-07-19 — Owner: Priya
- M2: Sandbox integration (Redwood) — Target: 2026-07-26 — Owner: Vanessa / Runtime team
- M3: Performance baseline & quantization profile agreed — Target: 2026-08-02 — Owner: Redwood Applied ML (Karthik)
- M4: Security & compliance evidence exchange (SOC2 excerpts, audit window) — Target: 2026-08-06 — Owner: NovusWare Security (Sam)
- M5: Pilot go-live (limited traffic) — Target: 2026-08-16 — Owner: NovusWare / Redwood CS (Marissa)

Key asks from us today:
1) Confirm owners and preferred dates for M1 & M4 (Priya / Sam)
2) Share test dataset access & any IP constraints by 2026-07-16
3) Confirm internal stakeholder list (engineering, security, procurement) to include on the Ops Passport

I also attached a draft SOW (NovusWare_SOW_draft.pdf) that includes estimated dedicated capacity and billing cadence — this is preliminary and not final.

Tentative CS kickoff: 2026-07-20 (30–45 min) — propose we lock this once owners/dates are confirmed.

If the milestones above look reasonable, I'll send an internal handoff note to CS with a proposed RACI and calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0163

Attachments: NovusWare_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet summary), NovusWare_SOW_draft.pdf (draft SOW)

From: Sam Park <sam.park@novusware.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <priya.desai@novusware.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 12:36:00 -0400
Subject: Re: MAP & Ops Passport — milestone commitments and CS handoff

Vanessa —

Thanks for the clear summary and the MAP draft. Priya (CC'd) will be our PM for the integration and will own M1. A couple quick notes from our side:
- We can commit to providing the test dataset and API access by 2026-07-18 (can move earlier if helpful).
- Security will need the SOC2 excerpts and a short questionnaire filled out; I can get that to you by 2026-07-20.
- For M3 (performance baseline), can we add a short acceptance metric: 95th pct latency < 350ms on the sandbox for the reference prompts? If Redwood can confirm this is reasonable, we'll mark M3 as accepted once the baseline is shared.

The dates look mostly good; would you be able to nudge M2 one week earlier (2026-07-19) to give us a little more runway before the baseline run? If that's tough we can keep 07-26.

I'll loop in our Security lead (if needed) after we confirm the kickoff.

Appreciate it — Sam
Samuel Park
Head of Platform Engineering, NovusWare
sam.park@novusware.com | +1 617-555-0198

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: MAP & Ops Passport — milestone commitments and CS handoff

Team — forwarding Sam's note and our MAP draft. NovusWare is aligned to the overall plan but asked to nudge the sandbox integration earlier if possible. Priya Desai (NovusWare PM) is now the primary owner for M1.

High-level asks for CS/Applied ML/Runtime (action items — please ack):
- Ben (CS): take ownership for M5 Pilot go-live and coordinate the pilot acceptance criteria with Sam (include traffic cap, SLO targets, and rollback plan). Target: have acceptance criteria doc by 2026-07-22.
- Marissa (CS Ops): schedule the CS kickoff meeting (propose 2026-07-20 10:00 PDT, 30 min) and prep the kickoff agenda. Add NovusWare Security to invite once Sam confirms.
- Karthik (Applied ML): prepare an initial performance baseline plan and a draft quantization profile; we aim to validate the 95th percentile latency target Sam requested. Deliverable: baseline run plan by 2026-07-19.

I'll update the Ops Passport spreadsheet with Sam's requested latency acceptance metric and move M2 tentatively to 2026-07-19 (pending resources). Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAP

Attachments: NovusWare_MAP_v1.xlsx, NovusWare_SOW_draft.pdf

Thanks — please reply-all with any schedule conflicts.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Jul 2026 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: MAP & Ops Passport — milestone commitments and CS handoff

Vanessa / team — ack and thanks for the clear handoff. A few quick notes:
- I'll own M5 as noted. Will draft pilot acceptance criteria and share by 2026-07-22. Will include traffic cap (100 rps max for pilot) and rollback triggers.
- Marissa: OK to schedule kickoff 07-20 10:00 PDT; I'll be on that call. Marissa, please add a short pre-read (Ops Passport highlights + acceptance metrics) to the invite.
- Karthik: happy to coordinate the baseline run with you; please share expected compute footprint so CS can schedule staging resources.

Also noting procurement / legal asked for an estimated billing cadence in the SOW — Vanessa, can you confirm monthly vs. quarterly billing preference from NovusWare? I'll keep procurement in the loop once we have a SOW version to present.

Thanks — Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0127
